intent: Topic Manager v1.2.1 patch: (1) Settings host-apply panes stop showing the last job's verdict, job id and details on every visit (James 2026-10-02, screenshot of Settings > System > Time source: 'the green text on every tab. builder.root_cause: (1) The five apply-status blocks bound applyJobs.<d> directly, and the page-open status check (runHostApply with no options) fills applyJobs with the LAST job's verdict, so every visit re-rendered that verdict, job id and details in green: the template had no notion of 'news' vs 'record'. (2) REG-0031: install/upgrade-full.sh's success path ran `trap - EXIT`, which removed the only handler that prints 'RESULT: exit <N>' (_on_exit had replaced result_line's trap), to keep a late failure from rolling back a finished upgrade.
